name: book-management-system
description: 前后端分离的图书管理系统

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.init-db: cd backend && python -c "from app import app, db; app.app_context().push(); db.create_all()"
scripts.seed: cd backend && python -c "from app import app, seed_data; app.app_context().push(); seed_data()"
